page.overview:
What is Very Informative Pig?

, also known as VIP, is the main antagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's: VIP.

VIP appears on the cover as a pink cartoon pig with large round glasses, a purple suit jacket, and a purple bowtie with slightly lighter purple polka-dots. However, in the book it describes him as having a black suit jacket with a loose red tie.

VIP presents himself as friendly, helpful, and lonely. He also claims to be able to predict what guests want, such as predicting that Devon should come to the Pizzaplex and that Ike needs to use the restroom. He is also shown rewarding what he deems is a good discovery with a cookie that resembles his own face. "A smart cookie for a smart cookie." He is described as sounding like a "Little kid with a stuffy nose".

VIP initially comes off as quirky and friendly, if a little bossy and cynical. However, he is shown to have a vicious temper and is extremely manipulative. He is willing to lock away Ike for hours (even suggests days) just so he can convince Devon to play along with his game so that he can fabricate reviews and get his VIP program going again.
